alt: A silver LAX SkyLink Innovia APM 300 automated people mover vehicle at the Maintenance and Storage Facility in 2022 — a brand-new airport train that has been waiting to open since 2023
credit: Los Angeles World Airports (LAWA) / Wikimedia Commons
story: The LAX SkyLink automated people mover — a 2.25-mile train linking terminals, parking, and the Metro — was originally due in March 2023; it has since missed targets for 2024, 2025, and October 2026, is now forecast to open January 6, 2027 at the earliest (still requiring 30 consecutive flawless test days), is more than $880 million over its original budget, missed the 2026 World Cup, and is now a central issue in the Los Angeles mayor's race.
why_funny: A train built specifically to solve the problem of nothing moving at LAX has set four consecutive opening dates across five years and missed every one — the only thing moving is the finish line.
